name: test-driver-crash-readpixels-none
title: glReadPixels with READ_BUFFER = NONE (crash-isolated)
summary: ES 3.0 §4.3.2.1 READ_BUFFER = NONE and missing-image errors; the integer-attachment cases that crash Mesa run in a re-executed child process whose exit status or signal the parent classifies.
spec: ES 3.0 §4.3.2.1 Obtaining Pixels from the Framebuffer

api.glReadBuffer: NONE, COLOR_ATTACHMENT0/1/3 and BACK accepted without error; READ_BUFFER read back after each
api.glReadPixels: INVALID_OPERATION with READ_BUFFER = NONE (FBO and default framebuffer) and with a read buffer that has no image, output buffer untouched; legal reads return the cleared RGBA8 / RG32I values; integer-attachment NONE cases run in a child process whose ending is classified
api.glGetIntegerv: READ_BUFFER values; IMPLEMENTATION_COLOR_READ_FORMAT/TYPE raise INVALID_OPERATION with READ_BUFFER = NONE and with a missing read image
api.glCheckFramebufferStatus: FRAMEBUFFER_COMPLETE with a read buffer that has no image
api.glClearBufferfv: RGBA8 attachment cleared; value read back in the parent and in the control child
api.glClearBufferiv: RG32I attachment cleared; (R, G, 0, 1) read back in the control child

visual_review.notes: 256x256 radeonsi capture (and 333x777): uniform (64,128,191) blue clear color, as expected; the test renders nothing else, all checks are error/readback checks.
